# Paladin — Protection

## Talent Prototype

Two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Canonical Classic identities/icons come from the Protection tree. Unlocks use only the structured tier thresholds; there are no per-node prerequisite chains.

identity.auto_attack: Guarded Strike — defensive melee Holy damage

tier_1.name: Improved Devotion Aura
tier_1.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

tier_2.name: Blessing of Kings
tier_2.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

capstones.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.
